# LeakSanitizer suppressions for AstronomyKit's AddressSanitizer CI job.
#
# swift-corelibs-xctest leaks its own run objects at process exit. Every
# scheduled `asan` run reported the same 368 bytes in 6 allocations, and every
# frame resolved inside libXCTest.so — the deepest named one being
# `$s6XCTest0A8SuiteRunC4testAc2AC_tcfC`, that is `XCTestSuiteRun.init(test:)`.
# None of it is AstronomyKit's memory: the 579 tests all pass, then LSan fails
# the job at teardown.
#
# The job exists to catch memory errors in native Swift storage and unsafe
# implementation boundaries. Suppressing this harness leak keeps that signal;
# it only silences the one allocation site the package does not own.
# Drop this file if swift-corelibs-xctest ever stops leaking.
leak:libXCTest.so
